name: Ichijou Mio
source: Youngest daughter of Ichijou sisters. Because she was spoiled or maybe its personality she tends to act much younger than her age despite being same age as protagonist.  She is often doted on by her sisters and brother. She very pure and naive compared to rest of family but has strong intuition when it comes to people an said to be the most honest with her feelings of sister. Is very attached to protagonist.
